rationale: With only 17 minutes to close, the price action shows a sharp intraday reversal — the stock ran to $112.50 and has since pulled back to $109.89, now trading below both VWAP ($110.05) and the 9-EMA ($110.25), with a large volatile candle (131K volume, $2.42 range) indicating indecision and potential distribution.
